news.title: License Encryption Issue: Regeneration and issuing of new licenses/keys coming soon!
news.author: System
news.content:
We have encountered an issue with the license registry and therefore all licenses will be regenerated and issued. Old licenses will continue to work until August 20th, 2026.
 Do not forget your key before then; they will be issued upon request once your account is created and approved.

news.title: Application Manager v3.2.2 Released (Pre-release)
news.author: EthanAVideos
news.content:
New features include helper scripts; to improve manager development, the manager is now a third-party handler for software licenses, and accounts are now required to obtain licenses
 and register them.

news.title: Application Manager v3.1.2 Released
news.author: EthanAVideos
news.content: New features include News category, improved permissions handling, and better launch mode management.

news.title: Tips: Using Launch Modes
news.author: System
news.content: You can now toggle between Cloud and Local launch modes. Cloud uses the configured launch command, while Local uses the detected executable. Toggle in Settings or per-app Options menu.

news.author: EthanAVideos
